球门面分布

红色表示更高条件密度，单位 m⁻²。图形采用非线性色标；门框外样本保留。下图放大各自落点区域、坐标仍为球门面物理位置；分别展示结构，不能按各图颜色深浅代替定量散布比较。

方程与选择规则

w = v − u
dr/dt = v
dv/dt = (0,0,−g) − ρπR² Cᴅ |w|w/(2m) + b×w
S = √tr Cov(y,z)

共同观测扰动后重新拟合各候选；先检查残差相容性、到达和失败分母，再比较未经密度平滑的样本散布。并列候选保留，选择冻结后使用独立随机流评估。关闭受力时同时移除相应反演自由参数。完整选择门限随配置导出。

算法定义与假设
{
  "input": "two observed positions, declared independent Gaussian coordinate sigma, an explicitly enumerated candidate set, model assumptions, finite sampling seed and budgets",
  "randomization": "the SAME observations + epsilon are passed to every candidate per index; selection and assessment use separate pseudorandom streams",
  "output": "prediction mapping F(p_0.05,p_0.10) -> candidate selection, nominal y/z/t predictions and independently assessed conditional uncertainty; KDE is a supplementary representation",
  "function": "F(d; config) = Predict_mhat(Fit_mhat(d)), with mhat = argmin eligible_m sqrt(trace(Cov_pilot(y,z))); ties retained. f_m(y,z) = I[z>=R] sum_i w_i exp(-((y-y_i)^2+(z-z_i)^2)/(2h^2))/(2*pi*h^2*Phi((z_i-R)/h))",
  "selectedFunction": "M0",
  "selectedFunctionIsProvisional": true,
  "modelWeightsInferred": false,
  "physicalValidationCompleted": false,
  "assumptions": [
    "Initial position and timestamps exact",
    "Independent, equal-variance Gaussian coordinate perturbations are user assumptions, not measured",
    "Wind for wind preset is a specified scenario, not inferred from six coordinates",
    "Effective Magnus b is not true angular velocity",
    "Kernel bandwidth controls density smoothing and is not a fitted physical uncertainty",
    "Each Gaussian kernel is truncated and normalized at ball-center ground height R; no truncation at goal posts or crossbar",
    "Minimum variance is a conditional decision criterion; independent measurements are needed to establish predictive accuracy"
  ]
}

使用物理基准 M0—M3 与声明的受力组合扩展。KDE为独立实现；统计分布传播参考 JCGM 101/102。仿真验证、数值验证与现实物理验证分别解释。
